title: Cache pose topology decisions in SkeletonSnapshot
description:
## Summary
Cache immutable pose-topology decisions in SkeletonSnapshot so per-tick pose rotation resolution does not rescan child relationships.

## User Mandate
> Please take everything from this good branch and take over for this agent:

STRICT. Preserve the uncaptured pose-topology caching finding from the reviewed follow-up branch without importing its raw task JSON or duplicate records.

## Scope
- Precompute the continuation-child and primary-child decisions needed by PoseRotationResolver.
- Store only immutable snapshot-derived decisions; do not add mutable generated state or a competing skeleton topology authority.
- Preserve deterministic tie-breaking, segment endpoint semantics, mirror/source-part behavior, and terminal fallback behavior.
- Fold with TSK-0193's helper-consolidation work where appropriate rather than duplicating resolution policy.

## Acceptance Criteria
- ResolveIntoCompatible no longer rescans children for each bone on every pose tick.
- Cached decisions are deterministic and invalidated by construction of a new SkeletonSnapshot.
- Existing pose rotations and terminal/mirrored behavior remain unchanged.
- Focused tests prove cache decisions match the current resolver across branches, terminals, ties, and degenerate endpoints.

## Validation
Run whole-project .NET compilation, focused runtime resolver tests, and Unity PlayMode validation for rig application. Record exact results and any unavailable Unity gate.

## Findings
The reviewed follow-up branch identified repeated child-topology scans in PoseRotationResolver.ResolveIntoCompatible. TSK-0193 covers helper consolidation/parity but does not itself cache the decision.

## Blockers
No implementation or Unity execution has been performed for this finding.

## Next Step
Extend TSK-0193 or implement the snapshot-owned cache with parity tests and allocation/per-tick evidence.

## Reconciliation
Renumbered from TSK-0199 on 2026-09-12. TSK-0199 now resolves uniquely to the in-progress resolved-Body-frame reuse task tsk-0199-reuse-resolved-body-frames-in-appearance-bake.
